verdict.rationale: The evidence shows keyboard-driven entry through typed syntax (`[[]]` page references, `(())` block references, the `/query` slash command) and an embedded PDF reader, with website embeds limited to the Whiteboard canvas. Community reports describe noticeable lag, slowdowns in large graphs, and failures when pasting multi-paragraph text, which undercuts the 'fast editor' part of the story. Missing for 10: any evidence of headings, callouts, tables or code blocks; documentation of media embedding inside the editor; evidence the editor is fast rather than laggy.
